title: James Lavish: Bitcoin Price Target, $400K–$500K by Mid-2029
summary: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine James Lavish: Bitcoin Price Target, $400K–$500K by Mid-2029 James Lavish told BMTV last month that he believes the bottom is in, and he says that cycle call still holds after hike odds spiked and tech stocks wobbled. This post James Lavish: Bitcoin Price Target, $400K–$500K by Mid-2029 first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Patrick Green .
